title: Warehouse Manager (f/m/d)
description:
You take responsibility for our central warehouse with 55 employees.

What you'll do
- Overall responsibility for goods receipt, storage, picking and dispatch
- Lead the team leaders, plan staffing and budget
- Develop warehouse processes and KPIs further
- Work with purchasing, sales and the freight forwarder

What you bring
- Several years of experience in warehouse management or as a team leader with development prospects
- Knowledge of SAP and KPIs
- Further training as a logistics master (Logistikmeister) or business economist (Betriebswirt) is desirable
